overview: The design contains a single independent Go service with no dependencies, so it is implemented in a single phase.

phases.name: Foundation Services
phases.description: Single standalone Go backend service providing the complete todo API including the new PATCH endpoint.

components.name: todo-api
responsibilities: Expose REST endpoints for creating, listing, retrieving, updating, and deleting todos
Implement PATCH /todos/{id} to toggle completion with completed_at timestamping
Enforce bearer-token authentication and per-owner authorization
Maintain thread-safe in-memory storage with mutex-guarded atomic updates
Provide /health endpoint and consistent JSON error responses
components.architectureContext: Standalone HTTP service on port 9090 serving clients directly; no downstream dependencies. It is the sole component of the system and handles auth, storage, and API logic internally.
keyConsiderations: Use sync.RWMutex around map[string]*Todo; perform the PATCH read-modify-write under a single write lock for atomicity/idempotency
JSON decoder must use DisallowUnknownFields and handle empty body defaulting completed=true
Return 405 with Allow header for unsupported methods; distinguish 401 vs 403 correctly
Ensure completed_at is set only on false->true transition and cleared when set to false; idempotent repeats must not change timestamp
Multi-stage Dockerfile with distroless/static base; include httptest-based unit tests for all status codes and idempotency
components.apiContract:
openapi: 3.0.3
info:
  title: Todo API
  version: 1.1.0
servers:
  - url: /
paths:
  /health:
    get:
      summary: Health check
      responses:
        '200':
          description: OK
  /todos:
    get:
      summary: List todos
      security:
        - bearerAuth: []
      responses:
        '200':
          description: List
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                type: array
                items:
                  $ref: '#/components/schemas/Todo'
    post:
      summary: Create todo
      security:
        - bearerAuth: []
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              type: object
              required: [title]
              properties:
                title: { type: string }
      responses:
        '201':
          description: Created
          content:
            application/json:
              schema: { $ref: '#/components/schemas/Todo' }
  /todos/{id}:
    get:
      summary: Get todo
      security:
        - bearerAuth: []
      parameters:
        - name: id
          in: path
          required: true
          schema: { type: string }
      responses:
        '200':
          description: OK
          content:
            application/json:
              schema: { $ref: '#/components/schemas/Todo' }
        '404': { $ref: '#/components/responses/Error' }
    patch:
      summary: Mark todo completion status
      security:
        - bearerAuth: []
      parameters:
        - name: id
          in: path
          required: true
          schema: { type: string }
      requestBody:
        required: false
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              type: object
              properties:
                completed: { type: boolean, default: true }
              additionalProperties: false
      responses:
        '200':
          description: Updated todo
          content:
            application/json:
              schema: { $ref: '#/components/schemas/Todo' }
        '400': { $ref: '#/components/responses/Error' }
        '401': { $ref: '#/components/responses/Error' }
        '403': { $ref: '#/components/responses/Error' }
        '404': { $ref: '#/components/responses/Error' }
        '405': { $ref: '#/components/responses/Error' }
    delete:
      summary: Delete todo
      security:
        - bearerAuth: []
      parameters:
        - name: id
          in: path
          required: true
          schema: { type: string }
      responses:
        '204': { description: Deleted }
        '404': { $ref: '#/components/responses/Error' }
components:
  securitySchemes:
    bearerAuth:
      type: http
      scheme: bearer
  responses:
    Error:
      description: Error response
      content:
        application/json:
          schema: { $ref: '#/components/schemas/Error' }
  schemas:
    Todo:
      type: object
      properties:
        id: { type: string }
        title: { type: string }
        owner: { type: string }
        completed: { type: boolean }
        completed_at: { type: string, format: date-time, nullable: true }
        created_at: { type: string, format: date-time }
    Error:
      type: object
      properties:
        code: { type: string }
        message: { type: string }
